rows.text: The Ministry of Human Resource Development's resolution No. F. 29-2/97-C&M of 29 September 1997, constituting a National Committee to observe the 50th Anniversary of Martyrdom of Mahatma Gandhi, lists under the heading 'PRESIDENTS OF ALL MAJOR NATIONAL POLITICAL PARTIES' '57. Shri Sharad Yadav, Janata Dal'.
